decisions.reason: Naming a replacement badge as a trailblazer referral badge does not change the amount or automatic distribution of coded-referral commissions.
The badge presentation change does not alter referral-ticket recipients or ticket quantities.
Badge icons and badge-set composition do not affect email magic-link authentication or dashboard access.
The badge changes do not modify ticket allocation for mints without referral codes.
The source changes badge presentation only and leaves the Big Block prize amounts, winner count, pool target, and draw condition unchanged.
The badge presentation decision does not change the Small Block prize mechanism or its draw trigger.
The badge-set and icon changes do not affect the fiat mint provider, conversion asset, or buyer access method.

The existing metadata requirement only requires permanent badges to remain visible; replacing or visually distinguishing badges does not invalidate that requirement or change its recorded visibility state.
Badge presentation does not alter the manual prize-claim payout mode.
The source does not change ticket eligibility, post-draw reset behavior, or carry-forward rules.
Badge-set composition and icon presentation do not affect authentication requirements or information exposed by public APIs.
The badge presentation changes do not affect the Brevo email provider or transactional email delivery behavior.
